SUBJECT:  PRESENTATION OF THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  MEETING MINUTES FOR THE MONTH OF OCTOBER 2019

SUMMARY
Presentation of the Public Safety Commission  Meeting Minutes for the
Commission's review and approval.

RECOMMENDATION
Approve the Public Safety Commission Meeting Minutes as presented for the
month of October 2019.

ATTACHMENT
Public Safety Commission Meeting Minutes for the month of October 2019.
   MINUTES
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  REGULAR MEETING
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  OCTOBER 16, 2019

The Regular Meeting of the Hawaiian Gardens Public Safety Commission was held on
Wednesday, October 16, 2019, and began at 6:00pm, at the Public Safety Center,
11940 Carson Street, 2nd Floor, Hawaiian Gardens, California 90716.

Pledge of Allegiance was led by Chair Laughlin.

ROLL CALL  CHAIRMEMBER  BARBARA LAUGHLIN  PRESENT
  VICE CHAIRMEMBER  LIZET MENDOZA  PRESENT
  COMMISSIONER  PEDRO AMARO  PRESENT
  COMMISSIONER  MARIO RICO  ABSENT
  COMMISSIONER  BERTHA MERAZ  PRESENT

A quorum was announced.

Also, in attendance, Councilmember Victor Farfan, Administrative Technician: Ramie
Torres, Sr. Administrative Analyst: Linda Suniga, Public Safety Officers: Verduzco and
Monjaraz, Recording Secretary: Mishaun Watkins and, with Los Angeles County
Sheriff's Department: Sergeant Maese along with Deputies Martinez and Portillo.

PRESENTATIONS

Staff presented newly appointed Councilmember Victor Farfan. He introduced himself
to the Commission and to the members in the audience. He expressed his appreciation
for the Public Safety Commission and their devotion to the community.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

Francis Rodriguez, resident, expressed her concerns regarding pedestrian safety at the
Teen Center, especially for those who are jaywalking. She suggested one way to get
the children to use the crosswalk would be to take the points away that they earn by
going to the Teen Center.

CITY COUNCIL REPORTS

  1. INFORMATIONAL ITEM: CITY COUNCIL MEETING 10/08/2019, OATH OF
  OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY APPOINTED COUNCILMEMBER
  VICTOR FARFAN.

PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
OCTOBER 16, 2019  Page 1 of 4
 CONSENT CALENDAR

  2. PRESENTATION OF THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION  MEETING
  MINUTES FOR THE MONTH OF SEPTEMBER 2019.

  COMMISSION ACTION: Approve as Presented.

  3. LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT MONTHLY CRIMES
  REPORT FOR SEPTEMBER 2019.

  COMMISSION ACTION: Receive and File.

  4. LOS ANGELES COUNTY ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL MONTHLY REPORT
  FOR AUGUST 2019.

  COMMISSION ACTION: Receive and File.

Commissioner Pedro Amaro made a motion to receive and file the Consent Calendar in
its entirety. Vice Chairmember Lizet Mendoza 2nd the motion, all in favor. Motion
passed.

ORAL STAFF REPORTS

Ramie Torres, Administrative Technician from Public Works reported on department
activities and responded to questions from the Commission.

UPDATE ON ANIMAL CONTROL

Linda Suniga informed the Commission that the Department of Animal Care and Control
will not be able to schedule canvasing anytime soon. The City relies on canvassing to
help with field enforcement. Animal Control is making unincorporated parts of Los
Angeles County a priority because the areas haven't been canvassed in years. We are
on the waiting list, but currently, they do not see an opening for the remainder of the
fiscal year.

UPDATE ON NOVEMBER MEETING

Staff will have a holiday dinner before the start of the November meeting. Staff
requested that the Commission arrive at 5:30PM for dinner. A reminder will be sent.
There is no need to cancel the November or December meetings, they do not interfere
with the holidays.

PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
OCTOBER 16, 2019  Page 2 of 4
 DISCUSSION ITEMS

  5. UPCOMING EVENTS

  •  RED RIBBON RALLY WALK, OCTOBER 22, 2019 @4:30PM. CORNER
  OF CIVIC CENTER DRIVE AND NORWALK BLVD.

  •  LAKEWOOD SHERIFF'S STATION HAUNTED JAIL & SAFETY EXPO,
  OCTOBER 25, 2019 @4:30PM-10:00PM. 5130 CLARK AVENUE,
  LAKEWOOD.

  •  HALLOWEEN PROGRAM, OCTOBER 31, 2019 @5PM-9PM.C. ROBERT
  LEE ACTIVITY CENTER (TENNIS COURTS).

  •  NEIGHBORHOOD SAFETY MEETING @ LAKEWOOD MOBILE
  ESTATES, NOVEMBER 6, 2019, 6PM.

  •  VETERANS DAY CEREMONY, NOVEMBER 11, 2019 @8AM-1 0AM.
  CITY HALL MEMORIAL.

Sergeant Maese reported that all city facilities have completed active shooter training.
He and the Deputies have visited each office and went over ideas on how to improve
safety in those areas. All trainings went well. Deputies went to all the local schools for
active shooter training with school staff. Sergeant Maese responded to questions from
the Commission.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

Commissioner Bertha Meraz reported attending the Neighborhood Safety Meeting, and
thanked Ms. Rodriguez for attending tonight's meeting and making comments. She is
also concerned about the kids crossing the street outside of the Teen Center.

Vice Chairmember Lizet Mendoza reported that she noticed skid marks from cars doing
donuts on 226 th and Norwalk around 4pm-5pm, which is early in the day. She is
concerned because this is near the Teen Center.

Sergeant Maese reported this is happening a lot in the City of Paramount. Their law
enforcement has an operation where they are tracking speed racers. Once the racers
get pushed out of one city, they make their way to others. Linda Suniga will inform
Deputy Emerson about this.

PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
OCTOBER 16, 2019  Page 3 of4
 Commissioner Amaro reported that he attended the Teen Center grand opening. He is
still concerned about the speed limit. Now, not only are teens jaywalking, but there is an
issue with double parking.

Linda Suniga explained that staff will reach out to the motor deputies and the Public
Safety Officers are focused on all parking violations. Concerns will be forwarded to the
appropriate departments.

Chairmember Barbara Laughlin thanked Ramie Torres for getting the light poll fixed and
thanked the Public Safety Officers for taking care of the city.

ADJOURNMENT to the next Regular Public Safety Commission Meeting on November
20, 2019.

  Respectfully,

  Barbara Laughlin
